Be,Ⓒv. i.ⒹBU 1 P, as 2 P, vft 1 A, vid 4 A; ‘b(e) it so’ Bavatu, evaM-taTA-astu.
ⓃBeing,Ⓒs.ⒹBAvaH, avasTA, vftti f., astitvaM, sattA.
Ⓑ
 2 BUtaM, sattvaH^1-tvaM; ‘rational b(eing)’ sacetanaH, prARin m.; ‘corporal b(eing)’ SarIrin m., dehin m.; ‘Supreme B(eing)’ parameSvaraH, paramAtman m.
Ⓑ
 2 janman n., saMBavaH, utpatti f.
Ⓔa.Ⓓsat, vartamAnaH ‘b(eing) that’ yataH, yasmAt; ex. by abl. or instr. of nouns.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20160906.
Bee,Ⓒs.ⒹaliH, BramaraH, dvirePaH, SilImuKaH, BfMgaH, maDukaraH, zadpadaH; ‘honey b(ee)’ saraGA, maDumakzikA; ‘b(ee) hive’ maDukozaH; ‘bees wax’ maDujaM, SikTaM.
